description: Permanently delete a short link: the /l/<slug> redirect stops working and the link's click history is deleted with it. Irreversible. Link ids come from aidelly_list_short_links. Returns 404 for unknown ids and for links in another workspace alike. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_delete_short_link
title: Delete Short Link
